home.description: Naturally handcrafted bath products that are safe for the whole family! Probiotic and antioxidant infused for health and skin benefits. No synthetic fragrances are used, only pure essential oils.
home.fit: **Core skincare, good fit.** Canadian, formulates in-house, and leads on full-ingredient transparency rather than hero ingredients — a defensible and differentiated angle. Breadth is the risk: skincare, makeup, haircare, baby care and 'Good Fumes' in one catalogue means creative has to pick a lane per audience rather than sell the brand.
